findings.title: Terminal success is not bound to job3360
findings.problem: The terminal predicate checks status, exit, counter and source but omits terminal.job_id. A complete result from a different job of the same source can satisfy this predicate if copied/stale at this path, while the correct3360 native step200 may already exist before3360 final evaluation/cleanup is finished. Native job_id binding does not establish the identity of the terminal result used to authorize this load.
findings.minimal_fix: Require terminal["job_id"] == "3360"; verify terminal["terminal_evidence_sha256"] against run/output/train200-terminal.json and validate its own job/run/source/config fields if present. Snapshot/recheck the added terminal evidence before/after. Do not require absent native.identity.run_id: the frozen native publisher does not emit it.
findings.resolution_evidence: Terminal job_id is required; actual train200-terminal JSON is hash-bound to run-result and inspected for completed200/final51713/own final-report path. Checked frozen train_monitor and validation_reports: the new expected status/fields match emitted schema.

findings.title: Bound config/package/verifier bytes lack post-verification immutability checks
findings.problem: resolved.yaml is hashed only before the long reload. Package manifest and frozen verifier are also only checked before execution. The final receipt nevertheless presents their fixed hashes as identity bindings. A persistent config change during reload is accepted by current post checks, which cover only base, checkpoint, native and run-result.
findings.minimal_fix: Snapshot actual wrapper, resolved config, package manifest and verifier hashes before starting; immediately before issuing success require the same actual hashes, including CONFIG/PACKAGE_SHA/VERIFIER_SHA, and put the pre/post evidence hashes in the receipt. This retains the frozen original verifier unchanged.
findings.resolution_evidence: wrapper/config/package/verifier/native/terminal receipt/terminal evidence are snapshotted, compared after reload, and retained as pre/post hash maps. Fixed pins are checked again before success.

findings.title: Tokenizer semantic identity is inferred from partial properties and three probes
findings.problem: Equal vocabulary, special IDs and chat_template do not ensure equivalent tokenization. tokenizer.json can differ in normalizer/pre-tokenizer/post-processor/decoder or AddedToken behavior on unprobed inputs while these checks and the three probes pass. The plan requires tokenizer semantic identity and describes full-special identity; special roles such as additional_special_tokens grouping and runtime tokenization options are not compared.
findings.minimal_fix: For an unchanged official tokenizer, compare canonical parsed tokenizer.json backend structures (or exact tokenizer.json bytes) and normalized relevant tokenizer configuration/special-token mappings, explicitly including AddedToken properties and special-token roles. Retain current encode/decode probes and add actual apply_chat_template checks. Account for expected serialization-only path fields rather than blindly equating tokenizer_config bytes.
findings.resolution_evidence: Full actual fast-tokenizer backend, normalized config, AddedToken attributes, special-token roles and runtime options are compared; actual chat rendering/token IDs are checked in four combinations.
